No dedicated slow-duration data value found; AuroraR.StunDuration's numbers [1.5/1.75/2] match the wiki's border-collision slow duration exactly, but the field name suggests it may actually govern a stun elsewhere (unclear naming, using it as the only matching bin row).

No bin data value matches; the shockwave expansion time is not a separate DataValue in the sheet (AuroraR.AreaDuration is the rift duration including this time, per r_3's note), so this figure is only derivable from the wiki text.
No matching DataValue in the sheet for the dash travel time; it appears to be hardcoded in the ability's animation/behavior data not exposed in this sheet.

mechanics.claim: The active is a direction-targeted magic-damage shockwave dealing damage to all enemies hit once.
mechanics.quote: unleashes a shockwave from {{tt|425 units|Estimated}} in front of her, expanding over {{fd|0.75}} seconds to deal {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit

mechanics.claim: Cooldown starts only after the full effect (including the rift phase) resolves, not on cast.
The shockwave applies a slow to enemies hit, separate from the later border-collision slow.
mechanics.quote: deal {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow}} them by 30% for 2 seconds

mechanics.claim: Aurora is displacement-immune and untargetable during her dashes (initial cast and rift-border dashes), which is a defensive survivability effect, not a damage one.
mechanics.quote: '''Aurora''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} in the target direction with {{tip|displacement immunity}} over {{fd|0.4}} seconds

mechanics.claim: Spell shield can block both the shockwave damage and the border collision effects.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} can block both the shockwave and border collision.
